collect_note: No call is open now: the Apply for funding page says the last window closed 15 January 2025 and future calls will be posted there. That page is checked twice a day and a new call with a stated closing date will be picked up.
zero_reason: Apply page (https://www.globalinnovation.fund/apply-for-funding, read 2026-11-12): "Our last application window closed on 15 January 2025. ... After our review of this window has concluded, we will share the details of future calls for proposals." FAQ (https://www.globalinnovation.fund/frequently-asked-questions): "GIF is not currently open for applications". Detection test: Wayback copy of the apply page from 2024-06-21 (https://web.archive.org/web/20240621194240/https://www.globalinnovation.fund/apply-for-funding) says "It will close on 30th June 2024 so please aim to complete your application before this deadline"; the engine's findDeadlines returns 2024-06-30 on that text (as of 2024-06-21), so a new window stated that way is collected. Known gap: the 2024-08-11 copy says only "It will next open between 1st and 30th September" (no year, no deadline word), which the engine does not read; a window announced like that would be missed.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET (desktop UA, 30 s): https://www.globalinnovation.fund/apply-for-funding 200 (45258 bytes): last window closed 15 January 2025, no future window stated; / 200, /investments, /what-we-do, /news, /growth, /partnerships, /learning-and-insights 200 with no call language; /apply/, /calls/, /opportunities/, /feed/, /rss, /wp-json/wp/v2/types 404; /sitemap.xml 200 (pages sub-sitemap lists apply-for-funding, application-process, innovating-for-climate-resilience, innovating-for-gender-equality); /applying-to-the-innovating-for-climate-resilience-fund 200 (eligibility text, no dated call). Checked 2026-11-12. Harness adapters/collect.ts and fetchSource not present yet, so this is verified by plain HTTP only.
